## Critique
- claim-1: Validated. It identifies the workspace provider, stable DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832`, and exact abstract field at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 124-131]. This satisfies the external-provider grounding requirement only.
- claim-2: Unsupported. Artifact `4c7e35abc20c97bff76a740a17bbdfb78234a2efbc0f0e6d90e80f3e4f5dd35e` lacks an inspectable output locator, executable code, resolver/input manifest, complete stdout/stderr, and SHA-256 digests for code, inputs, outputs, and artifact. Consequently, neither the asserted failed resolution nor exit status \(2\) is independently checkable. Moreover, twelve `null` values do not supply the required literal occurrence counts. The targeted-query count is \(3\), but the requested audit certificate is **not established**.

## Repair certificates
- [computation] Execute and persist a task-owned script over exactly `["persisted:source-39","persisted:source-29","persisted:source-30"]`, counting case-sensitive, overlapping exact UTF-8 byte occurrences of exactly `["Smith normal form","determinantal divisors","unimodular minors","Pieri matrices"]`; preserve all twelve counts, targeted-query count \(3\), executable code, complete stdout/stderr, exit status, output locator, and SHA-256 digests for code, inputs, outputs, and artifact.
- [source-refresh] Persist a resolver manifest mapping each requested persisted source ID to its exact byte-stream locator and content SHA-256, explicitly recording any failed resolution.

## Required revisions
- Supply an inspectable task-owned artifact rather than a bare artifact digest.
- Distinguish verified zero counts from unavailable (`null`) counts.
- Report the exact input and output digests and complete execution record.
- Conclude only whether this audit certificate is established; do not infer or claim the parent theorem.
